families.source: UKHSA guidance on responding to flooding
families.topic: actions during flood alerts, warnings and severe warnings, evacuation and immediate safety
evidence_points: Flood alerts and warnings provide different indications of expected risk.
People should move themselves, pets, vehicles and important items when safe to do so.
Gas, electricity and water supplies should only be turned off when it is safe.
A severe flood warning indicates danger to life and requires immediate action.
People in immediate danger should call emergency services and follow evacuation advice.
Emergency supplies should include lighting, communications, clothing, food, water, first aid and medicines.
